---
name: Reproduction or bug
about: Report a bounded software or owned-lab reproduction
---

Describe what you expected, what happened and the smallest reproduction.

Include software versions, relevant hardware and settings, exact commands with placeholders, and sanitized error text. Distinguish a simulated case from an appliance observation. For a measurement, include workload and counter/timing boundaries.

Do not attach raw JSONL, XML, PCAPs, keys, credentials, private addresses or third-party traffic. Security issues follow [the security reporting instructions](../../SECURITY.md).
